decisions.thought: Ting-Lu is bulky with Leftovers and Vessel of Ruin, but Grass is super effective vs Ground. Ogerpon outspeeds easily. A bare ivy cudgel may not guarantee the KO, especially at only 74% remaining HP. Using Swords Dance while safe (Ting-Lu can only Hit with neutral EQ) secures a +2 boost, making the follow-up attack likely an OHKO or near-OHKO. If they pivot, we have a free boost. This is the strongest tempo play.
